Diro_desc

r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d')

1 Importation des données

wd <- set_wd()

collision_faune_diro <- readr::read_csv(paste0(wd$data, "raw/collision_faune_diro.csv"))
## Rows: 43947 Columns: 19
## ââ Column specification ââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
## Delimiter: ","
## chr  (13): FID, geom, route, concessionpr, cote, district, cei, cigt, grp_espece, espece, comm...
## dbl   (5): id, deppr, pr, abs, annee
## date  (1): date_maj
## 
## â¹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## â¹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
diro <- collision_faune_diro %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    geom_x = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(geom, "POINT \\(([^ ]+)")[,2]),
    geom_y = as.numeric(stringr::str_match(geom, "POINT \\([^ ]+ ([^\\)]+)")[,2])
  )%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(geom))

diro_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(diro, 
                        coords = c("geom_x", "geom_y"), 
                        crs = 2154)

diro_sf <- sf::st_transform(diro_sf, 
                        sf::st_crs(4326))

carte_bretagne_44 <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data,                                    "masques/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale.shp"
                                    )) %>%
  sf::st_transform(2154)%>%
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(4326))
## Reading layer `Masque_Bretagne_Continentale' from data source 
##   `/home/onyxia/work/AnalyseDonneesOpportunisteGMB/data/masques/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale/Masque_Bretagne_Continentale.shp' 
##   using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Simple feature collection with 1 feature and 4 fields
## Geometry type: POLYGON
## Dimension:     XY
## Bounding box:  xmin: 123927.4 ymin: 6649996 xmax: 404382.1 ymax: 6882056
## Projected CRS: RGF93 v1 / Lambert-93
diro_conti <- sf::st_filter(diro_sf,
                            carte_bretagne_44, 
                            .predicate = sf::st_within)


diro_sf <- diro_conti%>%
  dplyr::filter(deppr != 44)

diro_sf <- diro_sf %>%
   dplyr::filter(!(espece %in% c("amphibien", "amphibiens", "autre", "autre oiseau",
                          "castor", "chat", "chauve-souris", "chien", "chouette",
                          "nr", "oiseaux sauf rapace", "rapace diurne", 
                          "rapace nocturne", "rapaces nocturnes", "rapaces diurnes",
                          "reptile", "reptiles")))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(paste(as.character(annee), mois, 01, sep="-")),
                espece = dplyr::if_else(commentaire == "Furet", 
                          "furet", espece, missing=espece),
                espece = as.factor(espece)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-date_maj, -annee, -mois, -commentaire, -grp_espece)

diro <- diro_sf%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

2 Analyse descriptive

2.1 Répartition frequence des espèces

diro%>% 
  ggplot()+
  geom_bar(aes(x=fct_infreq(espece), fill="#FFDB58"))+
  coord_flip()+theme_bw()+
  labs(title = "1. Repartition des especes de DIR Ouest",
       x = "Espece",
       y = "Nombre")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")

diro%>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    year = as.numeric(format(date, "%Y")),
    nom_vernaculaire_grp = fct_lump(espece, prop = 0.03)
  ) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(year, fill = nom_vernaculaire_grp)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "2. Repartition des differentes especes observes",
    x = "Periode",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Espece"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")

diro%>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(as.factor(wday(date, 
                            week_start = getOption("lubridate.week.start", 1))),
                      fill="#FFDB58"))+
  labs(title="3. Barplot des observation selon le jour de la semaine",
       y="Nombre d'observations",
       x="Jour de la semaine")+ 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_bar()+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("1" = "Lundi", 
                            "2" = "Mardi",
                            "3" = "Mercredi",
                            "4" = "Jeudi",
                            "5" = "Vendredi",
                            "6" = "Samedi",
                            "7" = "Dimanche"))

diro %>%
  dplyr::mutate(jour_annee = qday(date)+(quarter(date,with_year = FALSE)-1)*91)%>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(jour_annee, fill="#FFDB58")) +
  labs(title="4. Frequence des observations selon le jour de l'annee",
       y="Proportion",
       x="Jour de l'annee")+
  geom_density()+theme_bw()

diro%>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(aes(factor(month(date)), fill="#FFDB58"))+
    labs(title="5. Barplot des observation selon le mois",
         y="Nombre d'observations",
         x="Mois")+ 
    theme_bw()+
    geom_bar()+
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("1" = "Janvier", 
                              "2" = "Fevrier",
                              "3" = "Mars",
                              "4" = "Avril",
                              "5" = "Mai",
                              "6" = "Juin",
                              "7" = "Juillet",
                              "8" = "Aout",
                              "9" = "Septembre",
                              "10" = "Octobre",
                              "11" = "Novembre",
                              "12" = "Decembre"))

diro%>%
  ggplot(aes(date, col="#FFDB58"))+
  labs(title=paste("6. Frequence des observations dans le temps"))+ 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_line(stat="density")

2.2 Répartition géographique des données

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = carte_bretagne_44) +
  geom_sf(data = diro_sf) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "7. Toutes les donnees DIR Ouest utilises")

repartition_espece_geo <- function(bdd = diro_sf, nom_espece, num_graph=1){
  grille_10x10 <- sf::st_read(
    paste0(wd$data, "masques/Grille_10x10/Grille_10X10.shp")
  )
  RegionBretagneConti <- sf::st_read(
    paste0(wd$data, "masques/RegionBretagneConti/RegionBretagneConti.shp")
  )
  
  diro_sf <- diro_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(espece == nom_espece)%>%
    transforme_carte()
  grille_10x10 <- grille_10x10%>%
    transforme_carte()
  RegionBretagneConti <- RegionBretagneConti%>%
    transforme_carte()
  
  grille_10x10$density <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(grille_10x10, 
                                                    diro_sf))
  grille_10x10 <- sf::st_intersection(grille_10x10, 
                                      RegionBretagneConti)

  g <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = RegionBretagneConti) + 
    labs(title = paste0(num_graph, ". Densite des observations du ", 
                        nom_espece, " en bretagne")) +
    geom_sf(data = grille_10x10, aes(fill = density)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="orangered3") +
    theme_bw()

return(g)
}
